dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Lemon Ginger was surrendered as a stray so we have no history on her behavior in a home environment. Lemon Ginger has shown highly fearful behavior while at the care center, avoiding handling and showing reluctance to exit her kennel. In calmer environments with time to warm up, she has shown social and affiliative behavior with handlers. Due to her fearfulness, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide a period of decompression and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
